acceptance: The cause of the slow `node.EXE` start is identified from CI logs (cold start, antivirus scan, missing cache, or other) and written in this item.
Twenty consecutive Windows CI runs of these tests pass without a re-run.
context: The classification as unrelated came from the delegated agent's reading of the failure; the logs were not re-read by the session leader.
description:
Flaky test. On PR #4175 (head bc7139178d) the Windows job failed on two `test_sqlglot_delivery_workflow` tests that timed out after 20 seconds on `node.EXE`; the change under test did not touch that area and the jobs were re-run. A required-path failure that is cleared by re-running hides real failures and costs a CI round (over an hour on 2026-11-12).

Expected: the tests pass reliably on Windows runners, or the timeout reflects measured start-up time there.

Guardrails: do not mark the tests skipped on Windows without the owner's decision; do not add a blanket retry.
